meta.title: A vendor cannot convert an RFQ

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event with one QA vendor invited, no bids, and its bidding window (with the extra closing time) already over.
steps: The buyer sends the request that converts a round into an auction, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not authorized to perform this action”, and never with a server error.
